description:
Standard data for one country: the structured record plus its freshness, at the $1 tier. REQUIRES PAYMENT.
      XRPL   : 1 XRP  via x_payment_signature + x_inv_id
      Solana : $1.00 USDC via x_sol_payload
      Base   : $1.00 USDC via x_base_tx

    Args:
        slug: Country slug (e.g., "thailand")
        x_payment_signature: JSON string containing tx_hash AND signedTxBlob
            (hex-encoded signed XRPL tx). Both are required: the t54
            facilitator decodes the blob to bind the on-chain InvoiceID.
        x_inv_id: Invoice ID
        x_sol_payload: OPTIONAL. base64 of an x402 PaymentPayload paying USDC
            on Solana. When present it is verified AND settled via the local
            facilitator; the XRPL arguments are then ignored.
        x_base_tx: OPTIONAL. Hash of your own USDC transfer on Base
            (eip155:8453) to the payTo in the payment_required error. Verified
            on-chain and consumed once; the other arguments are then ignored.
name: xrplme_get_country_schema
